prompt: We ran a MaxDiff on 25 product benefits last year and want to run it again this year with 5 new items added and 3 old ones swapped out. Can we compare the utility scores across waves to see which benefits have grown or declined in importance?
assertions: Explicitly states that raw MaxDiff utilities cannot be compared across studies with different item sets
Explains why: different item sets produce different normalizations, making raw utilities non-comparable
States that anchored share-above-anchor is the valid cross-wave metric
Addresses what to do if prior wave was unanchored (re-field or flag the limitation clearly)
